description:
Pay a TEST store's pending order with no chain and no money: it confirms at once through the same path a real payment takes, so the items are granted, the receipt is issued (claim livemode: false, the test store's storeId) and the iap.order.confirmed webhook goes to the test store's own webhook with livemode false. Repeating it returns the confirmed order. Use a test store key (cd_iap_test_…, scope orders:write, via CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY) or a session that manages the store.

Params: order_id (0x + 64 hex), session_token?
Returns: {ok, order: Order} with status 'confirmed'
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, HTTP_403 (scope), HTTP_404 (unknown order, or TEST_MODE_DISABLED), HTTP_409 (LIVE_ORDER: a live order is paid on chain; ORDER_EXPIRED)

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_test_pay
title: Pay a test order
